title: Local facts (spec 8.13.1): no /.well-known/local-fact endpoint in any stack; Rust/C implementations absent; caller-side seq cache absent (R-06-336/351)
description: Gateway-issued local facts exist only as a Python library: python/src/lichen/gateway/local_facts.py — all nine claims (lichen:emergency, emergency_callback, relay, priority, channel, quota, sponsored, expiry, seq) with strict validation (:43-53, :113-151), issue_local_fact :335-356, verify_local_fact :359-431 with the §8.13.1 fail-closed MUSTs (expiry-without-current-time reject :414-417, seq-without-cache reject :418-422, bootstrap -1 :383-385, update-only-after-verify atomic-with-acceptance caller contract :387-391). Tests: python/tests/gateway/test_local_facts.py. Gaps: (1) POST /.well-known/local-fact CoAP endpoint absent in ALL stacks (grep: zero hits); (2) no Rust/C implementation (issue or verify); (3) no production caller-side per-issuer seq-cache store (the 'atomic with acceptance' cache is a documented caller contract only); (4) lichen:expiry/seq SHOULD-include on every issued fact (§8.13.1) not enforced by an issuance default. Credentials machinery (COSE_Sign1/x5chain) tracked separately under bedw epic. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/local_fact.py + site mount; rust gateway resource; C coap_server resource; seq-cache store in each gateway.
